mapper.select:
SELECT (CASE WHEN ISDATE(WO.접수일자) = 1 THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), CONVERT (DATE, WO.접수일자) , 126) ELSE WO.접수일자 END) AS W_RCEPTDE , WO.일련번호 AS W_SN , RTRIM(IC.품목코드) AS IC_CODE , RTRIM(IC.품목명) AS IC_NM , RTRIM(IC.규격) AS IC_STNDRD , WO.단가 AS W_UNTPC , (CASE WHEN ISDATE(WO.접수일자) = 1 THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), CONVERT (DATE, WO.접수일자) , 126) ELSE WO.접수일자 END) AS W_ORDERDE , (CASE WHEN ISDATE(WO.납기일자) = 1 THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), CONVERT (DATE, WO.납기일자) , 126) ELSE WO.납기일자 END) AS W_DEDT , WO.수량 AS W_QUANTITY , WO.중량 AS W_WT , WO.단가단위문자 AS W_UNIT_CHRCTR , WO.단가 AS W_NEWUNITPC , WO.합계금액 AS W_SUMAMOUT , WO.착지업체 AS W_ALOCENTRPS , WO.주문비고 AS W_NOTE , WO.관리자비고 AS W_ADMINNOTE , (SELECT RTRIM(CM2.상호) FROM 거래처MASTER CM2 WHERE CM2.거래처코드 = WO.착지업체 AND CM2.등록사업장 = WO.출고사업장) AS DLVYENTRPSNM , IC.업체전용구분 AS IC_ENT_DVR_SE , IC.생산구분 AS IC_PRDCTN_SE , CONVERT(VARCHAR(8),DATEADD(DD, 5, #{listStartDt}),112) AS listStartDt
ORDER BY WO.착지업체 DESC, WO.납기일자, RTRIM(IC.품목명)
mapper.sql: FROM 웹주문접수 WO JOIN 품목코드 IC WITH(NOLOCK) ON (WO.단가사업장 = IC.사업장 AND WO.품목코드 = IC.품목코드)
